newsitem.title: USA: Solucorp in $64.5 mln deal with UK firm.
newsitem.headline: Solucorp in $64.5 mln deal with UK firm.

text.p: Solucorp Industries Ltd said Tuesday it has signed an agreement giving its licensee in the United Kingdom, John Beech Ltd, an exclusive license for Europe for its Molecular Bonding System (MBS) process for $64.5 million.

Peter Mantia, president of Solucorp, said the agreement provides the company with much needed capital via upfront and annual licensing paymetns due in fiscal 1997, royalty payments and a percentage of profits.

Solucorp said in its announcement that because John Beech is a private company that is currently reviewing the possibility of being listed in an exchange, further details of the agreement are being withheld, on lawyer's advise and at the request of John Beech itself.
Solucorp develops and sells enviromental solutionpreoducts, focusing on solving problems of heavy meaetls contanination.
